items.title: Arthur Vigne Interview, 1961-11-29
items.q: Well, my mother partly raised those two boys. ... They rented a little room upstairs in the back of our house. ... But their mama and their dad was always working and my mother used to feed them and everything.

ctx.x: He started off with a little tin flute with six holes in it. Then he got one flute he used to blow from the side with six holes. Then he got so good on that, he turns around and he buys him a clarinet. Then there was a fella by the name of Rene. Oh, yeah, Kid Rene.
Kid Rene and his brother Joseph.
